title: Convoro 1.0 — the first stable release
notes: Convoro is 1.0: feature-complete and stable. This release adds rich media embeds, RSS feeds, importers for XenForo / phpBB / Discourse / vBulletin, one-click digest unsubscribe, and worldwide privacy compliance.

changelog.text: Convoro 1.0 — a realtime, AI-native community platform that is now feature-complete and stable: WYSIWYG composer, live theme editor, marketplace, 45+ languages, moderation & GDPR tooling, PWA + push, and a self-updater.
Rich media embeds — paste a YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify, X, Facebook or Instagram link on its own line and it renders inline automatically.
RSS feeds add-on — site-wide, per-category and per-topic feeds with auto-discovery links.
Move from almost any forum — the Import wizard now migrates from XenForo, phpBB, Discourse and vBulletin in addition to Flarum (older platforms marked beta; back up first).
Email digests now include a one-click unsubscribe link that works without signing in.
Worldwide privacy compliance — the cookie-consent add-on honors Global Privacy Control / Do Not Track, adds a CCPA “Do Not Sell or Share” notice, and keeps a persistent “Privacy choices” link.
